title: AMD reports Q1 revenue up 38% YoY to $10.25B, Data Center revenue up 57% to $5.8B, and forecasts Q2 revenue above estimates, as AI chip demand stays strong (Zaheer Kachwala/Reuters)
summary: Zaheer Kachwala / Reuters: AMD reports Q1 revenue up 38% YoY to $10.25B, Data Center revenue up 57% to $5.8B, and forecasts Q2 revenue above estimates, as AI chip demand stays strong — Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) forecast second-quarter revenue above Wall Street expectations on Tuesday, betting on resilient demand …
